description_en: Deletes an application assignment record and revokes the access of a specified principal to a specified application
description_zh: 删除应用分配记录，撤销指定主体的指定应用使用权限
kebab_example: aliyun ims delete-application-assignment --app-id '472457090344041****' --principal-name user@example.onaliyun.com --principal-type user --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteApplicationAssignment

parameters.help_en:
The user principal name or role name.

User principal name: The format is `<username>@<account-id>.onaliyun.com`. You can query it by calling the `GetUser` or `ListUsers` API operation.
Role name: You can query it by calling the `ListRoles` API operation of RAM
parameters.help_zh:
RAM 用户主体名称或角色名称。

用户主体名称：格式为`<username>@<account-id>.onaliyun.com`，可通过调用`GetUser`或`ListUsers` API 查询。
角色名称：可通过调用 RAM `ListRoles` API 查询
parameters.name: principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the target principal for the application assignment. Valid values:
user: The principal is a RAM user. In this case, PrincipalName must be a user principal name.
role: The principal is a RAM role. In this case, PrincipalName must be a role name
parameters.help_zh:
应用分配的目标主体类型。

user：主体类型为 RAM 用户，此时 PrincipalName 必须是用户主体名称。
role：主体类型为 RAM 角色，此时 PrincipalName 必须是角色名称
parameters.name: principal_type
